story: Tang was the leader of the Shang, a people living east of the Xia on the Yellow River plain. From his base at Bo, and with his able minister Yi Yin, he first conquered smaller allies of the Xia, such as the state of Ge.

When he was strong enough, Tang marched against Jie, the last Xia king. Before the campaign he told his troops that the Xia had committed many crimes and that Heaven had ordered him to punish it. The two armies met at Mingtiao. The Xia army was beaten, and Jie fled to Nanchao, where he died in exile.
Tang then became king of a new dynasty. The exact site of Mingtiao is disputed: some place it in southern Shanxi, others near Fengqiu in Henan.
story_zh: 汤是商族的首领，商人生活在夏的东边，同在黄河平原上。汤以亳为根据地，在贤臣伊尹的辅佐下，先后灭掉了葛国等夏的盟邦。
实力足够之后，汤出兵讨伐夏朝最后一位君主桀。出征前他对将士说，夏犯下了许多罪行，是上天命令他去惩罚夏。两军在鸣条交战，夏军大败，桀逃到南巢，最后死在那里。
汤随即建立了新王朝。鸣条的具体位置有争议，有人认为在山西南部，也有人认为在河南封丘一带。
mingtiao.why: Tang's victory became the first model of a just revolt against a tyrant, an idea the Zhou later developed into the Mandate of Heaven.
mingtiao.why_zh: 商汤灭夏成为“以有道伐无道”的第一个范例，后来周人把这一思想发展为“天命”观。

people.name: Tang
people.role: Founder of the Shang

people.name: Jie
people.role: Last king of the Xia

people.name: Yi Yin
people.role: Tang's chief minister

quote.en: The Xia has committed many crimes, and Heaven has ordered me to destroy it.
quote.from: Book of Documents, Speech of Tang 尚书·汤誓

story: In its early centuries the Shang moved its capital several times, possibly because of floods, quarrels within the royal family or the search for better land. King Pan Geng ended this by moving the court to Yin, near today's Anyang. Many nobles did not want to move, and the Book of Documents preserves three speeches in which he urges them to follow him.

Yin stayed the capital for the rest of the dynasty, more than two hundred years. It grew into a large city along the Huan River, with palace and temple halls, royal tombs, bronze foundries, bone and jade workshops, and pits holding chariots and sacrificed people.
Scientific digging at Yinxu, 'the ruins of Yin', began in 1928. It was the first time a site confirmed a dynasty known from the old histories. Yinxu became a World Heritage Site in 2006.
story_zh: 商朝前期多次迁都，原因可能是水患、王族内部的纷争，或是为了寻找更好的土地。商王盘庚把都城迁到殷（今河南安阳附近），结束了频繁迁徙的局面。当时不少贵族不愿搬迁，《尚书·盘庚》三篇就记录了他劝说臣民随迁的讲话。
此后直到商亡，二百多年间殷一直是都城。它沿洹河发展成一座大城，有宫殿和宗庙建筑、王陵、铸铜作坊、制骨和制玉作坊，还有埋着车马和人牲的祭祀坑。
殷墟的科学发掘始于1928年，这是第一次用考古遗址证实古书记载的王朝。2006年，殷墟被列入世界遗产名录。
yin.why: Yin gave the Shang a stable centre for two centuries, and its ruins hold most of what we know about the dynasty.
yin.why_zh: 殷都让商朝有了两百多年的稳定中心，我们对商朝的了解大多来自殷墟。

people.name: Pan Geng
people.role: Shang king who moved the capital to Yin

story: Shang kings asked their ancestors and gods about almost everything: rain, harvests, hunts, wars, illness and childbirth. Diviners drilled hollows into turtle shells or the shoulder blades of oxen and applied heat until cracks appeared. The king read the cracks, and scribes carved the question and often the answer into the bone.

Most surviving inscriptions date from the reign of Wu Ding onward. About 150,000 pieces have been found at Anyang, using some 4,000 different characters, of which roughly a third can be read with confidence.

The bones were rediscovered in 1899, when the scholar Wang Yirong noticed writing on 'dragon bones' sold as medicine. The inscriptions confirmed the list of Shang kings given in the Records of the Grand Historian.
story_zh: 商王几乎事事都要向祖先和神灵请示：下雨、收成、狩猎、战争、疾病、生育。占卜者在龟甲或牛肩胛骨上钻出凹槽，再用火烧灼，使其出现裂纹。商王根据裂纹判断吉凶，史官再把占问的事情、往往连同结果一起刻在甲骨上。
现存的卜辞大多是武丁以后的。安阳已出土约15万片甲骨，所用单字约4000个，其中能确切释读的约占三分之一。
1899年，学者王懿荣注意到中药“龙骨”上刻有文字，甲骨文才重新被人们发现。卜辞中的商王世系与《史记》的记载基本吻合。
oracle-bones.why: Oracle bones are the oldest large body of Chinese writing. Their script is the direct ancestor of modern Chinese characters.
oracle-bones.why_zh: 甲骨文是现存最早成体系的汉字材料，它的字形是现代汉字的直接源头。

people.name: Wu Ding
people.role: Shang king whose reign left the most inscriptions

people.name: Wang Yirong
people.role: Scholar who identified the inscriptions in 1899

story: In 1929 a farmer named Yan Daocheng found a pit of jade objects while digging a ditch near Guanghan in Sichuan. Little more was done until 1986, when workers making bricks hit two large pits packed with bronzes, gold, jade and elephant tusks.

The finds were unlike anything from the Shang: a bronze standing man 2.6 metres tall, masks with eyes bulging out on stalks, a bronze tree almost 4 metres high, and a gold-covered staff. The objects seem to have been broken and burned on purpose before being buried, probably in a ritual.
Six more pits were opened from 2019 to 2022. The site dates to about 1200 to 1000 BCE and is linked to the ancient kingdom of Shu. No writing has been found there.
story_zh: 1929年，广汉的农民燕道诚在挖水沟时发现了一坑玉器。此后很长时间没有更多进展，直到1986年，砖厂工人取土时挖到两个大坑，里面堆满了青铜器、金器、玉器和象牙。
这些器物与商文化完全不同：有高2.6米的青铜立人像，眼球像柱子一样向外凸出的面具，近4米高的青铜神树，还有包金的权杖。它们在掩埋前似乎被故意砸碎和焚烧过，很可能与某种祭祀有关。
2019年至2022年又发掘了六个祭祀坑。遗址年代约为公元前1200年至前1000年，一般认为与古蜀国有关。这里至今没有发现文字。
sanxingdui.why: Sanxingdui shows that Bronze Age China had several advanced centres, not just the Shang on the Yellow River.
sanxingdui.why_zh: 三星堆说明中国青铜时代有多个发达的中心，并不只有黄河流域的商。

people.name: Yan Daocheng
people.role: Farmer who made the first find in 1929

story: Yi Yin is remembered as the minister who helped Tang found the Shang. Traditional stories say he began as a cook or a servant in a bride's household and won Tang's trust by explaining government through cooking.

After Tang died, Yi Yin served his successors. When Tang's grandson Taijia became king, he ignored the laws of his grandfather and behaved badly. Yi Yin sent him to live at the Tong palace near Tang's tomb for three years, and ruled in his place.

Taijia repented, and Yi Yin returned power to him. Taijia then ruled well. An alternative account in the Bamboo Annals says that Yi Yin seized the throne and was later killed by Taijia. Oracle bones show that later Shang kings still offered sacrifices to Yi Yin.
story_zh: 伊尹被后人记作辅佐商汤开国的贤臣。传说他出身低微，当过厨师或陪嫁的奴仆，用烹调的道理向汤讲解治国之道，因而得到重用。
汤去世后，伊尹继续辅佐几代商王。汤的孙子太甲即位后，不遵守祖父定下的法度，行为暴虐。伊尹把他安置到商汤墓地附近的桐宫，让他闭门思过三年，自己代为执政。
太甲悔过后，伊尹把政权交还给他，太甲此后成为好君主。不过《竹书纪年》的说法不同：伊尹篡位，后来被太甲所杀。甲骨卜辞显示，后来的商王仍然祭祀伊尹。
yi-yin-exiles-taijia.why: Yi Yin became the model of a loyal minister who may correct even a king, an example later regents such as the Duke of Zhou and Huo Guang cited.
yi-yin-exiles-taijia.why_zh: 伊尹成为“忠臣可以匡正君王”的典范，后世的周公、霍光等摄政者常以他为榜样。

people.name: Yi Yin
people.role: Chief minister of early Shang

people.name: Taijia
people.role: Shang king, grandson of Tang

story: In 1950 a schoolteacher in Zhengzhou picked up pottery and stone tools at Erligang, on the edge of the modern city. Digging revealed a huge early Shang city buried beneath the streets.

Its rammed-earth walls ran almost 7 kilometres around and were about 20 metres thick at the base. Inside were large palace foundations; outside were bronze foundries, bone and pottery workshops, and cemeteries. In hoards near the walls, archaeologists found big square bronze cauldrons, the largest about a metre tall.

Many scholars think it was Bo, Tang's capital, while others link it to Ao, a later early Shang capital. The Erligang style of bronzes found here spread across a wide area, from Shaanxi to the Yangtze.
story_zh: 1950年，郑州一位小学教师在城郊二里岗捡到陶片和石器。随后的发掘揭示，现代城市的街道下面埋着一座巨大的商代前期城址。
城墙用夯土筑成，周长近7公里，墙基宽约20米。城内有大型宫殿基址；城外有铸铜、制骨和制陶作坊以及墓地。考古人员在城墙附近的窖藏中发现了大型青铜方鼎，最大的高约1米。
不少学者认为这里就是商汤的都城亳，也有人认为是商代前期另一座都城隞。这里所代表的二里岗风格青铜器分布很广，西到陕西，南到长江。
zhengzhou-shang-city.why: Zhengzhou shows that early Shang was already a large state with a planned capital and organised bronze production.
zhengzhou-shang-city.why_zh: 郑州商城表明，商代前期已经是一个拥有规划都城和组织化青铜生产的大国。

story: Panlongcheng lies on a lake shore in Huangpi, north of Wuhan, about 500 kilometres south of Zhengzhou. It was found in 1954 after a flood, and major digs took place in 1974.

The town had a small rammed-earth wall enclosing large palace buildings, with houses, workshops and cemeteries outside. The bronzes, jades and pottery in its tombs look almost exactly like those of Zhengzhou, and the buildings follow Shang plans.

Many scholars think the Shang founded Panlongcheng to control the Yangtze and to secure copper from the rich ore fields of the middle Yangtze. It was abandoned around the time the early Shang centre at Zhengzhou declined, and direct Shang control of the middle Yangtze faded after that.
story_zh: 盘龙城位于武汉北面黄陂区的湖边，距郑州约500公里。它在1954年的一次洪水后被发现，1974年进行了大规模发掘。
城址不大，夯土城墙内是大型宫殿建筑，城外分布着房屋、作坊和墓地。墓中出土的青铜器、玉器和陶器与郑州所见几乎一模一样，建筑布局也遵循商人的规制。
许多学者认为，商人在这里筑城是为了控制长江，并获取长江中游丰富的铜矿资源。大约在郑州商城衰落的同时，盘龙城也被废弃了，此后商人对长江中游的直接控制也逐渐消退。
panlongcheng.why: Panlongcheng shows how far early Shang power or influence reached, and how much the state depended on metal from the south.
panlongcheng.why_zh: 盘龙城说明了商代前期的势力或影响能达到多远，也说明商朝对南方金属资源的依赖。

story: In 1999 archaeologists surveying north of the Huan River at Anyang found the buried walls of a city they had missed for seventy years of digging at Yinxu, just across the river.

The city was almost square, about 2.2 kilometres on each side. Inside, a palace area held some of the largest Shang buildings known, including a courtyard hall about 170 metres long. Yet the outer wall was never finished, and the palace area shows signs of burning.

The city dates to the middle Shang, between the time of Zhengzhou and the time of Yinxu. Some scholars think it was the city Pan Geng first moved to; others link it to King Hedanjia. Soon after it was abandoned, the Shang court built its new centre at Yinxu south of the river.
story_zh: 1999年，考古人员在安阳洹河北岸调查时，发现了一座埋在地下的城址。七十多年来，殷墟的发掘就在河对岸进行，却一直没有注意到它。
这座城近似正方形，每边约2.2公里。城内宫殿区有已知规模最大的商代建筑之一，其中一座四合院式的宫殿长约170米。但外城墙始终没有修完，宫殿区还留有火烧的痕迹。
它的年代属于商代中期，介于郑州商城和殷墟之间。有学者认为这是盘庚最初迁去的都城，也有人认为与商王河亶甲有关。它被废弃后不久，商王朝就在河南岸的殷墟建起了新的中心。
huanbei-shang-city.why: Huanbei fills the gap in the archaeological record between early and late Shang and complicates the simple story of Pan Geng's move.
huanbei-shang-city.why_zh: 洹北商城填补了商代前后期之间的考古空白，也让“盘庚迁殷”的简单说法变得更加复杂。

story: Wu Ding ruled the Shang for about 59 years and is remembered as its greatest king. The oracle bones from his reign record many wars against neighbouring peoples, such as the Tufang and the Qiang.

The Guifang lived on the high ground to the northwest, probably in today's Shanxi and northern Shaanxi. The Book of Changes says that Wu Ding, given the temple name Gaozong, attacked the Guifang and needed three years to defeat them. The Bamboo Annals record the same campaign.
The long war shows that Shang power had to be won by force on every side. Later Zhou texts still remembered the Guifang as a dangerous northern enemy.
story_zh: 武丁在位约59年，被认为是商朝最伟大的君王。他那个时期的卜辞记录了许多对周边族群的战争，对象有土方、羌方等。
鬼方居住在西北高地，大约在今山西和陕北一带。《周易》说，庙号高宗的武丁讨伐鬼方，用了三年才取胜，《竹书纪年》也记载了这次征伐。
这场旷日持久的战争说明，商朝的势力需要在四面八方靠武力去争取。直到周代，文献中仍把鬼方记作北方的强敌。
wu-ding-guifang.why: Wu Ding's wars expanded and secured Shang power at its height and brought in captives, many of whom were used as labour or sacrificed.
wu-ding-guifang.why_zh: 武丁的征战让商朝在鼎盛时期扩大并巩固了势力，也带回了大批俘虏，其中许多人被用作劳力或人牲。

people.name: Wu Ding
people.role: Shang king, temple name Gaozong

quote.en: Gaozong attacked the Guifang and took three years to conquer them.
quote.from: Book of Changes 周易·既济

story: Fu Hao was one of the wives of King Wu Ding. Her name appears in more than 200 oracle bone inscriptions. They show her leading troops against the Qiang, the Tufang and the Yi, once with an army of about 13,000 men, the largest force recorded in the inscriptions. She also carried out sacrifices and held her own land.

In 1976 archaeologists at Yinxu found her tomb. It was the only Shang royal tomb never robbed. It held nearly 2,000 objects, including more than 460 bronzes, about 750 jades, around 7,000 cowrie shells used as money, and bronze axes that were symbols of military command.
She died before Wu Ding, who asked in his divinations about her health and childbirth. Her tomb has made her the best-known woman of the Shang.
story_zh: 妇好是商王武丁的妻子之一，她的名字在200多条甲骨卜辞中出现。卜辞显示她曾率军征伐羌方、土方和夷方，有一次统领约一万三千人，这是卜辞所见规模最大的一次用兵。她还主持祭祀，拥有自己的封地。
1976年，考古人员在殷墟发现了她的墓，这是唯一一座未被盗掘的商代王室墓葬。墓中出土器物近两千件，包括460多件青铜器、约750件玉器、约7000枚用作货币的海贝，还有象征军权的青铜钺。
她比武丁先去世，武丁曾多次占卜她的病情和生育。这座墓让她成为最为人熟知的商代女性。
fu-hao.why: Fu Hao's record shows that royal women in Shang could hold military and religious power, and her tomb gives a full picture of Shang royal wealth.
fu-hao.why_zh: 妇好的事迹说明商代王室女性可以掌握军权和祭祀权，她的墓也完整呈现了商代王室的财富。

people.name: Fu Hao
people.role: Wife of Wu Ding and general

people.name: Wu Ding
people.role: Shang king

story: The Houmuwu ding is a rectangular bronze cauldron 133 centimetres tall and weighing about 833 kilograms. Its inside wall bears three characters, read as 'Hou Mu Wu', meaning it honoured a royal mother whose temple name was Wu. She was probably a consort of Wu Ding, and a son who became king had it made.
Making it required melting more than a tonne of metal in many furnaces at once and pouring it into a set of clay piece-moulds. The handles were cast separately and joined to the body.

Villagers at Wuguan near Anyang dug it up in 1939, during the Japanese occupation. They reburied it to keep it hidden and brought it out again in 1946. It is now in the National Museum of China in Beijing.
story_zh: 后母戊鼎是一件长方形青铜大鼎，高133厘米，重约833公斤。鼎腹内壁铸有“后母戊”三个字，意思是祭祀一位庙号为“戊”的王室之母。她很可能是武丁的配偶之一，此鼎由她做了商王的儿子下令铸造。
铸造这件鼎，需要多座熔炉同时熔化一吨以上的铜液，再浇入由多块陶范拼合成的铸型。鼎耳是单独铸好后再与鼎身连接的。
1939年日军占领期间，安阳武官村的村民挖出了这件鼎。为了不让它落入日军之手，他们又把它重新埋了起来，直到1946年才再次挖出。它现藏于北京的中国国家博物馆。
houmuwu-ding.why: It is the heaviest bronze vessel known from ancient China and shows the scale of labour and skill the Shang state could organise.
houmuwu-ding.why_zh: 它是中国古代已知最重的青铜器，体现了商朝能够调动的人力规模和技术水平。

story: The Zhou were a people of the Wei River region west of the Shang. Under their leader Danfu, later honoured as the 'Old Duke', they lived at Bin, in the hills to the north. Raiders known as the Rong and Di attacked them again and again.

Rather than fight, the histories say, Danfu left Bin with his followers and crossed the hills to the plain below Mount Qi. Many people followed him there. The Zhou built a town, laid out fields and set up officials. The plain became known as Zhouyuan, 'the plain of Zhou'.
An ode in the Classic of Poetry celebrates the move. Archaeologists have found large buildings, bronze hoards and oracle bones at Zhouyuan, which remained a Zhou centre for centuries.
story_zh: 周人生活在商的西边，属于渭河流域。在首领古公亶父（后世尊称“太王”）的时代，他们住在北面山地中的豳，屡遭戎狄侵扰。
史书记载，古公亶父不愿与之交战，而是带着族人离开豳，翻山来到岐山脚下的平原，许多人也随他迁来。周人在这里筑城、开垦田地、设置官吏，这片平原从此称为“周原”。
《诗经》中有一首诗专门歌颂这次迁徙。考古人员在周原发现了大型建筑、青铜器窖藏和甲骨，这里在此后几百年间一直是周人的重要中心。
gugong-danfu-zhouyuan.why: The move gave the Zhou fertile land and a secure base from which Danfu's grandson King Wen and great-grandson King Wu would challenge the Shang.
gugong-danfu-zhouyuan.why_zh: 这次迁徙让周人获得了肥沃的土地和稳固的基地，古公亶父的孙子周文王和曾孙周武王正是从这里起步，最终挑战了商朝。

people.name: Danfu
people.role: Zhou chief, later called King Tai
people.role_zh: 周族首领，后被追尊为太王

quote.zh: 古公亶父，来朝走马，率西水浒，至于岐下。
quote.en: Old Duke Danfu came in the morning, galloping his horses, along the banks of the western river to the foot of Mount Qi.
quote.from: Classic of Poetry, Mian 诗经·大雅·绵

story: Ji Chang, later called King Wen, was the grandson of Danfu and a vassal of the Shang. The histories say Di Xin, the last Shang king, grew suspicious of him and held him prisoner at Youli. Tradition credits him with arranging the hexagrams of the Book of Changes while in captivity. His followers won his release with gifts of women, horses and treasure.

Back home, King Wen built alliances and conquered neighbouring states that were loyal to Shang. The most important was Chong, near the Feng River. After taking it, he moved his capital from Zhouyuan east to a new city at Feng.
King Wen died soon after. His son, King Wu, built Hao across the river and finished the conquest of Shang. Feng and Hao together formed the Zhou capital, Fenghao.
story_zh: 姬昌，即后来的周文王，是古公亶父的孙子，也是商朝的臣属。史书记载，商纣王对他起了疑心，把他囚禁在羑里。相传他在被囚期间推演了《周易》的卦象。他的臣下献上美女、良马和珍宝，才使他获释。
回国后，文王广结盟友，征服周边依附商朝的方国，其中最重要的是丰水边的崇国。攻下崇国后，他把都城从周原东迁到新建的丰邑。
文王不久便去世了。他的儿子周武王在河对岸建了镐京，并最终灭商。丰、镐两地合称丰镐，是西周的都城。
king-wen-builds-feng.why: The move to Feng put the Zhou on the open Wei plain, closer to the Shang, and created the capital of the coming Western Zhou.
king-wen-builds-feng.why_zh: 迁都丰邑让周人进入开阔的渭河平原，更加接近商朝，也奠定了后来西周的都城。

people.name: King Wen of Zhou
people.role: Zhou leader, father of King Wu

people.name: Di Xin
people.role: Last Shang king

quote.en: Having attacked Chong, he built his city at Feng.
quote.from: Classic of Poetry, Wen Wang You Sheng 诗经·大雅·文王有声

story: Di Xin, remembered as King Zhou of Shang, was the last king of the dynasty. Late Shang inscriptions record long campaigns against the Yifang, the Yi peoples living in the Huai valley and Shandong. Some of these campaigns lasted for months, and bronze inscriptions mention captives and loot.

The wars won land and prisoners, but they kept the best Shang troops far from the capital. Ancient writers later saw this as a fatal mistake. The Zuo Commentary says that Zhou of Shang conquered the Eastern Yi but lost his own life.

Many prisoners of war were brought back to the Shang lands. When King Wu of Zhou attacked, Shang had little strength left in the west, and much of its army that met him at Muye may have been made up of these captives.
story_zh: 帝辛，即后人所说的商纣王，是商朝的最后一位君主。商代晚期的卜辞记录了对“夷方”的长期征伐，夷方指生活在淮河流域和山东一带的夷人。有些征伐持续数月之久，青铜器铭文中也提到了俘虏和战利品。
这些战争带来了土地和俘虏，却让商朝的精锐部队长期远离都城。古人后来认为这是致命的失误。《左传》说，纣征服了东夷，自己却因此丧命。
大批战俘被带回商的领地。周武王进攻时，商在西面已没有多少力量可用；在牧野迎战周军的商军，可能有不少就是这些俘虏。
di-xin-dongyi.why: The eastern wars spread Shang culture into the Huai region but weakened the dynasty just as the Zhou were ready to strike.
di-xin-dongyi.why_zh: 东征把商文化传播到淮河流域，却在周人蓄势待发之际削弱了商朝。

people.name: Di Xin
people.role: Last Shang king, King Zhou of Shang
people.role_zh: 商朝末代君主，即商纣王

quote.en: Zhou of Shang conquered the Eastern Yi and lost his life.
quote.from: Zuo Commentary, Duke Zhao year 11 左传·昭公十一年

story: After King Wen died, his son King Wu carried on his plans. According to the Records of the Grand Historian, in the ninth year after taking power he led his army east to the Mengjin ford on the Yellow River, carrying a wooden tablet for his father.

There, eight hundred lords arrived without being summoned. All of them said that Zhou of Shang could now be attacked. King Wu replied that they did not yet know Heaven's will, and he led his army home.
Historians read this as a test of support. Two years later, after news of more cruelty and unrest at the Shang court, King Wu returned to Mengjin, crossed the river and marched to Muye.
story_zh: 周文王死后，他的儿子周武王继承了他的计划。据《史记》记载，武王即位第九年，带着父亲的木主，率军东进到黄河边的孟津渡口。
在那里，八百个诸侯没有约定就自行赶来会合，大家都说可以讨伐商纣了。武王却说：你们还不知道天命，现在还不行。于是率军回师。
史学家认为这是一次试探人心的行动。两年后，商朝内部更加混乱残暴的消息传来，武王再次来到孟津，渡过黄河，向牧野进军。
mengjin-gathering.why: The gathering showed how many lords had turned against Shang and set up the decisive campaign of 1046 BCE.
mengjin-gathering.why_zh: 这次会盟显示了有多少诸侯已经背弃商朝，也为公元前1046年的决战做好了准备。

people.name: King Wu of Zhou
people.role: Zhou leader who later overthrew Shang

quote.zh: 诸侯不期而会盟津者八百诸侯。
quote.en: Eight hundred lords gathered at Mengjin without having been summoned.
quote.from: Records of the Grand Historian, Annals of Zhou 史记·周本纪

story: Bigan was a royal prince, an uncle of Di Xin. The histories say that as the king grew more cruel and indifferent to government, his relatives tried to stop him.

Weizi, the king's elder half-brother, gave up and left the court. Jizi, another uncle, pretended to be mad and was enslaved. Bigan insisted that a minister must remonstrate even at the risk of death and kept pressing the king. According to the Records of the Grand Historian, Di Xin flew into a rage and said he had heard that a sage's heart has seven openings. He had Bigan cut open to look at his heart.
Confucius later called Weizi, Jizi and Bigan 'the three men of virtue of the Yin'. Soon after, the Zhou attacked.
story_zh: 比干是商朝王子，纣王的叔父。史书记载，纣王越来越残暴，荒废政事，宗室亲族都想劝阻他。
纣王的庶兄微子劝谏无效，离开了朝廷；另一位叔父箕子装疯，被贬为奴隶。比干认为做臣子的即使冒死也要进谏，于是不断苦劝。据《史记》记载，纣王大怒，说：我听说圣人的心有七个孔窍。于是下令剖开比干，观看他的心。
孔子后来称微子、箕子、比干为“殷有三仁”。不久之后，周人便起兵伐商。
bigan-killed.why: Bigan became the classic example of a loyal minister who dies for speaking the truth to a tyrant.
bigan-killed.why_zh: 比干成为“忠臣冒死直谏暴君”的经典形象。
